findings.text: The company status is recorded as dissolved, and it ceased on 29 October 2024.

The accounts were last made up to 30 September 2022, and their overdue status is unknown because no next due date is recorded.
The confirmation statement was last made up to 14 September 2023, and its overdue status is unknown because no next due date is recorded.
One person with significant control is recorded: PERSON 312, an individual with 75 to 100 percent ownership of shares and voting rights and the right to appoint and remove directors.

The sole recorded director is PERSON 311, appointed on 15 September 2021, who has 2 other dissolved appointments; no officer changes or registered office address changes were filed since 24 October 2025.
No charges are registered against the company.
